help: UNIQUE -- No more than 1 enhancement of this type may be slotted by a character.  Grants you a 20' radius aura which increases your Henchmen's Defense by 5%.  NOTE: This enhancement cannot be slotted into a mastermind pet, or pet that doesn't benefit from recharge enhancements.
power_display_names: Call to Arms:  Defense Bonus Aura for Pets
